Our story

For Miami dessert lovers after something more special than a scoop, BETWEEN makes premium ice cream sandwiches in deliberate flavor combinations — served quickly through a beautiful neighbourhood ventanita.

It starts in the middle

The name says it plainly: the good part is what's in between. We build each sandwich as one composed idea — the right ice cream, the right wafer or cookie, an inclusion with a job to do, and a finish that ties it together.

No endless topping bar, no guesswork. Just a short menu of flavors worth driving for, wrapped to travel and easy to gift.

Made in Miami

Guava, café con leche, dulce de leche, key lime and coconut show up in our seasonal drops and local collaborations. It's the city on a wafer — familiar, warm and a little unexpected.

We're growing in chapters: markets and the truck first, then a small window when the flavors have earned it.

Good things happen between.
